title: WoW in other games?!
author: SizzBass
selftext: Is it possible to put World of Warcraft in other games, like minecraft? Idk much about this whole decompiling thing, but I've been wanting it since I was a kid

comments.author: Unnamed-3891
comments.body: There is this whole thing called Intellectual Property. And lawyers.

replies.author: SizzBass
replies.body: Well clearly none of that matters because people have put Minecraft in Elden Ring

replies.author: Unnamed-3891
replies.body: The only clear thing is that you are quick to jump to conclusions.

replies.author: Unnamed-3891
replies.body: You may find being on the hook for millions to be fun. I assure you, most other people do not.

replies.author: SizzBass
replies.body: Have a good day random internet redditor

replies.author: Unnamed-3891
replies.body: Have you worked out your new pick up line already? "Instead of making my own shit for fun, I decided to infringe on property rights of a multi-trillion behemoth and now owe them $10 million" is gonna get them so wet.

replies.author: CarthagoFuckYourself
replies.body: You're not on the hook for anything if you don't distribute, and a lot of the game combination videos you've seen are just a translation layer. Basically a mod for both games running at once. Totally kosher in terms of IP infringement.

replies.author: i_rate_slop
replies.body: That's not going to stop people from doing it.

replies.author: Unnamed-3891
replies.body: And getting smacked down for it. We didn’t magically enter some weird era of computing where trillion dollar behemoths suddenly no longer care about their IP and rights enforcement.

replies.author: i_rate_slop
replies.body:
You're focused on the consequence of distribution. OP never said they wanted to distribute anything, they just asked about jamming two games together. You can do that perfectly legally so long as you're not setting it lose.

But it's a big world and US copyright/IP law is not respected everywhere.

replies.author: TheReviewerWildTake
replies.body:
Nah, blizzard will not care what he is doing on his PC, with his outdated versions of those clients that are available for fooling around...,   
Unless he runs an open private server with any meaningful traction, monetization and population to be noticed and picked for cease and desist -  this won\`t be an issue.

replies.author: Unnamed-3891
replies.body: Oh I mean sure, if you intend to tinker about with shit without ever releasing it to the general public, who cares.

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: Yes just go on twitter. People merged it with dark souls, skate, call of duty

comments.author: MeatMan49
comments.body:
I already saw someone who put skate 3 in World of Warcraft

I also don’t know how to do it, but I do know there is a rewritten version of classic wow out there you can download, that’s a good starting point

comments.body: What does that even mean? Models? Gameplay? Music? Maps? Netcode?
